svg.title: Each layer's world model
svg.desc: Three rows, one per layer, each a colored label on the left and a panel on the right. Blue, Deliberative (planner, agent): kit on agv1: c1, c2, c3 placed; slot 4 open; c4 is good; agv1 is at INSPECTION; no poses, no single readings. Amber, Executive (GP1 tree): /tester1/cell = c4, /tester1/voltage = 3.599, /kit/slots_filled = 3, /kit/total = 10.87. Green, Reactive (skills, ARIAC): joint positions of inspection robot 2, gripper width, TF2 frame of agv1's tray slot 4.
